name: @starkom/evm-verifier

scripts.vectors:fri: cargo run --release --manifest-path tools/fri-vectors/Cargo.toml > test/vectors/fri.json && prettier --write test/vectors/fri.json
scripts.vectors:plonk: cargo run --release --manifest-path tools/plonk-vectors/Cargo.toml --bin cases -- test/vectors/plonk && prettier --write test/vectors/plonk
scripts.vectors:merkle: cargo run --release --manifest-path tools/plonk-vectors/Cargo.toml --bin merkle -- test/vectors/merkle && prettier --write test/vectors/merkle

author: Alberto La Rocca <alr@libernet.xyz>
description: Starkom proof verifier for the EVM.
